messages:
maria: Quick thought — we should show an 'Effective permissions' preview in the role editor that includes routing policy outcomes and quota status. Helps support/SEs debug why a request was routed or rejected. Thoughts?

aj: +1. Do you mean per-route policy + quota windows? Also need to show which model variants and affinity tiers a role can hit.

sam: I like it, but we must avoid UI bloat. Suggest a collapsible panel with a sample request simulator and a small table: route -> decision -> reason -> quota state.

nina: Telemetry is critical here — the preview must link to the audit trace id and surface recent real failures for that role. Preview without traces is misleading.

kevin: Backend note: we already have a prototype endpoint: GET /api/v1/roles/:id/evaluate?route=... returns the evaluated decisions and matched policies. Perf is the concern if the console fires too many calls.

maria: Agreed on perf. Plan: make it async, client polls, and cache evaluations for 30s keyed by (role, route, simulated_token). Show a cached badge if response is stale.

dev-bot: deploy: permissions-eval service canary deployed to staging at 3543219999 :rocket:

aj: UX nit: distinguish tenant-level overrides vs role-level grants. Color badges: green=allowed, amber=allowed_but_quota_exceeded, red=denied. Tooltip with policy id and last-evaluated timestamp.

sam: Also need 'view as' dropdown for impersonating service accounts/scoped tokens. Edge case: scoped tokens might inherit route-claims differently. We should simulate token claims in the request form.

nina: Telemetry items: add a counter perm_preview_used, histogram eval_latency_ms, and emit evaluation_version tag. Tie errors to recent support tickets so we can measure if preview helped triage.

kevin: Security concern: limit the eval endpoint to admin+console service principal. Redact sensitive policy predicates (customer keys, internal flags) in the console response. Also add rate limiting: 10 requests/min per principal.

maria: Actionable plan: 1) API contract PR (kevin), 2) console mock + wording (aj), 3) staging canary + caching (kevin/sam), 4) E2E simulated request test (sam), 5) telemetry dashboard + alert (nina). I'll open a tracking RFC and link PRs.

aj: I'll take the console mock. Will include collapsed table + simulator + color legends. Expect mock by EOD tomorrow.

sam: I'll add E2E test skeleton that hits the eval endpoint with simulated requests and asserts decision states for common scenarios (allowed, denied, quota_exceeded, fallback).

nina: I'll draft the dashboard panel and an alert: spike in perm_preview_used OR eval_errors > 1% triggers SE review. Also will add a pointer to support-scripts for correlating previews with tickets.

kevin: On the API PR, I'll add the rate limit and redact rules. One ask: include a version field in response so old console builds can detect incompatible shape.

maria: +1 on versioning. Also, preview should show 'allowed but quota_exceeded' explicitly when a route is permitted but tenant quota or route quota is exhausted. Don't hide it as a generic denial.

aj: Good call — UX will show explicit states and microcopy: "Allowed but quota currently exhausted — request would be routed to fallback or rejected depending on policy."

sam: Minor: include example curl in the console Help: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://console.redwood.local/api/v1/roles/ROLE_ID/evaluate?route=/v1/generate&input=hello"```

maria: Great. I'll open the RFC and assign owners. Tagging followups: @aj for mock, @sam for tests, @nina for telemetry, @kevin for API changes. We'll canary in staging next week and gather support feedback.

aj: ack.

sam: ack, will stub tests today.

nina: ack — will add query to internal metrics dashboard.

kevin: ack — starting API PR now.

maria: Thanks everyone. If no blockers, aiming for a small staging canary by Thursday. :white_check_mark:
